programme.desc: Tennant and NCIS must take down a notorious team of international thieves using WWII explosives on armored trucks before they complete their final big job and disappear. Also, Kai searches for a new place to live; Lucy and Whistler have a standoff about their previous encounter; and Ernie’s mission in the field is more alarming than he expected.

programme.title: Recruiter
programme.desc: Kai goes undercover with one of Hawai`i’s oldest surf gangs when a petty officer who’s trying to help wayward kids find a new path in the Marines is murdered.

programme.title: Season 3 Episode 1
programme.desc: In a shocking, random act of violence, a young woman is knocked to the ground, after being punched in the face by a stranger.

programme.title: Season 3 Episode 2
programme.desc: 80-year-old Rose has fluid on her lungs and is having trouble breathing.

programme.title: Season 3 Episode 3
programme.desc: 39-year-old Neil was driving a friend's sports car when he was involved in a head-on collision with another vehicle.

programme.title: Good as Gold
programme.desc: Big changes are in store for season six of the Emmy-nominated Million Dollar Listing New York, with one agent newly married, one agent newly spiritual, and one agent....well, NEW.

programme.title: The Kids Aren't Alright
programme.desc: Ryan and his newly-formed Brooklyn team are selling as many houses as they possibly can, but things get more difficult when he discovers he might have to sell the most expensive one twice.

programme.title: The Shark, The Smooth-Talker and the New Kid
programme.desc: Fredrik lands a listing in the "greenest building in the world".
programme.sub-title: The Shark, The Smooth-Talker and the New Kid

programme.title: Bondi Rescue
programme.desc: It could be the start of a big career for the trainees, but it's the end for veteran lifeguard Harry Nightingale.

programme.title: Bondi Rescue
programme.desc: For ten years Trent Maxi Maxwell has been a shining light of positivity for the lifeguards, but all good things must come to an end.

programme.title: Bondi Rescue
programme.desc: In tonights epic season finale, mother nature throws the lifeguards a new challenge.

programme.title: Horse Racing: King George VI & QE Stakes
programme.desc: The world's best middle-distance horses gather at Ascot for the 76th running of the King George VI & QE Stakes, Britain's most prestigious open-age flat race.

programme.series-desc: A news show hosted by Kiryu Coco in which she summarizes the events of the day before. Coco-Kaichou often pitches products as commercial breaks such as her drug AsaCoco which can be inhaled, injected or consumed as a drink. It is tradition to watch Cocos AsaCoco Live News and afterwards Tsunomaki Watames "Watame no Uta" (early morning karaoke format with viewer rock-paper-scissor).

programme.title: People and Power
programme.desc: Keeping the Revolution alive. After Maduro's capture, we followed the people fighting for his return.
programme.series-desc:
People & Power is a current affairs programme on Al Jazeera English which broadcasts once a week, on Wednesdays, and repeated throughout the week.
Each half-hour programme features one investigative documentaries on an issue related to power from around the world. The programme occasionally has one hour specials.
